messages.author: b5a9541b775d8382
messages.subject: Run shiny-server as non root
parts:
Hello
We have built shiny-server from source and can run the server as user shiny or root. The run_as in shiny-server.conf is 'shiny' 
The issue we have is 
a- When shiny-server is started as 'root' all the applications running under user 'shiny' get the correct environment variables and works fine
b- When shiny-server is started as user 'shiny', the environment variables is a very barebones version. All the variables required for the application are not available

Any idea how to ensure that all the variables are available running non root?

Thanks in advance

GK

messages.author: 3da48b33a2f506a9
messages.subject: Re: Run shiny-server as non root
parts:
You can define the variables either globally in:

/etc/profile

or for "shiny" user in on of the following files: 

/home/shiny/.bash_profie 
/home/shiny/.bash_login
/home/shiny/.profile
